candidates.title: LLM Inference in a Flash!
candidates.reason: Very recent Compute-in-Flash inference work directly aligned with SSD/NVMe research: end-to-end integer-only inference plus dictionary-based KV compression designed for Flash compute-in-memory constraints. Primary arXiv reports 15x reduction in dynamic KV-cache traffic with limited accuracy degradation on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen-2.5-7B.
